## Overview

**House Price Prediction in Cambodia** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). Khmer24 house prices: cleaning, feature engineering, and ML valuation per step-by-step guideline.

## Background & Motivation

**House Price Prediction in Phnom Penh** — detailed PDS guideline on repo with step-by-step data cleaning rules.

Residential buyers in Phnom Penh lack transparent valuation when listings mix USD/KHR formats, vague room counts, and inconsistent location tags.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

**From *Project guideLine* (House Price Prediction):**

- **Goal:** Predict house price from location, size, bedrooms, bathrooms, condition
- **Data source:** **Khmer24**
- **Steps:** (1) Data collection (2) Cleaning — strip `$`/`, validate prices, impute bedroom/bathroom `3+` as average 3 (3) **Feature engineering** — combine rooms; drop rare categories; scale; feature selection (4) **Model selection** — compare ML regressors (5) Evaluate on separate test set

## Data Collection & Preparation

Khmer24 house listings with price, location, size, bedrooms, bathrooms, condition.

## Methodology & Analysis

Regex price cleaning; rare-category collapsing; normalization; feature selection algorithms; multiple regression candidates.

## Model Evaluation

Separate test dataset per guideline; compare model accuracy.

## Results & Key Learnings

Reproducible Phnom Penh house valuation pipeline documented for PDS grading.
